conclusion: End-to-end simulated transfers succeed for compressible and random payloads up to the tested sizes under clean and mild channels, and with 3% independent frame loss inside the RS erasure budget. The harsh channel is the stress case; its failures are recorded per trial with the failing stage. Simulated wall time is a software benchmark, not screen time: the projected 60 fps screen time and projected net bit rate are reported separately for protocol planning.

summary.note: Simulated wall time measures the Python pipeline. Projected screen time = frames / 60 fps; projected net bit rate uses that screen time. Neither is a physical camera measurement.

title: End-to-end simulated transfer
